spec.purpose: Isolated replacement of the carry representation across the original six scalar GDN dots in WU, recurrent state and output. Preserve original packed BF16 operands, all shared layouts, scalar product arithmetic, ordered K16 alignment, masks, BF16 checkpoints and residuals, output FMA order, FP32 state and U=V ownership. A compact FP32 carry is accepted only while every original group endpoint is normal or zero; invalid operand rows, tiny groups and endpoint overflow restart the complete original dot. Compare every raw output and intermediate, original nonaliased inputs, inactive U, guards and independent CPU columns. Safety covers six lengths through1024 with zero, finite and subnormal cases. Throughput uses8192 rows with one warmup and three rotated attempts across original and new variants and both U ownership modes. Completed host timing includes the full WU/state/output chain and all fallback. Same-stream phase events resolve after final completion with no intermediate host synchronization. Generated full-length recurrence differs from production1024-row partitioning; no model, token, inference, performance or release qualification follows.

compiled_kernel_resources.scope: Static compiler declarations, not measured occupancy.

implementation: Replace only the carry representation in all six original scalar GDN dots with the existing strict FP32 K16 accumulator. The original packed BF16 LDS data, kernel bodies, scalar products, masks, ordered groups, checkpoint/residual BF16 rounding, output FMA and FP32 state remain. Every rejected fast dot restarts the complete original dot, including invalid rows, tiny groups and overflowing or subnormal endpoints. No provider option or product dispatch changes.
correctness_scope: Host sanitizers compare7680 accepted full dots against independent wide integer groups, and verify4608 declined calls leave output untouched.64/128-wide dots with4/8 right columns cover signed zeros, cancellation, wide supported exponents, unsupported late operands, endpoint overflow and tiny groups. Native72 safety reports cover six lengths and zero/finite/subnormal cases with original versus new kernels and both U ownership modes. All raw outputs, final states, W/U, BF16 checkpoints and residuals, immutable inputs, inactive U buffers and redzones are checked. Independent CPU columns validate WU and complete recurrence. Full q8192 data is generated, not a new model or GB10 token boundary.
timing_scope: Four same-stream HIP events observe WU, state and output; durations resolve after the original final completion with no intermediate host synchronization. Joint completed host clocks include event overhead, all shared preparation and complete fallback. One warmup and three rotated samples per variant/alias check every result. Allocation, reset, upload and validation remain outside the clock. Full8192-row recurrence differs from production1024-row segmentation. Safety timing zeros are placeholders, not measurements. Phase medians need not sum to the joint median.

decision.decision: Keep the compact carry kernels isolated. The complete q8192 chain changes84.6648 to74.9052 ms with separate U, but81.0788 to80.6714 ms with the production U=V ownership pattern; the samples overlap and vary. These observations do not establish a seconds-scale product gain. All numerical and ownership checks pass, but no provider integration, GB10 token run or retained performance follows.
